purpose: Explicit, reviewable ordering contracts for migrations whose functions, triggers, constraints or RPCs depend on objects introduced earlier. This is a curated dependency graph, not a replacement for PostgreSQL execution or a complete SQL parser.

dependencies.reason: The manager authorization helper reads organizations and organization_memberships.
Invitation workspace RPCs call can_manage_org(uuid).
Organization membership management calls can_manage_org(uuid).
The active-organization gate replaces the previously installed helper.
The registration guard uses the platform-owner singleton.
The permission matrix is attached to team staff assignments.
Roster assignments reference legacy teams and team staff.
Training sessions and attendance are scoped to legacy teams and roster assignments.
Calendar events are scoped to legacy teams.
Matches and lineups are scoped to legacy teams and roster assignments.
Finance entries are scoped to legacy teams and team permissions.
Team events are scoped to legacy teams.
Team tasks are scoped to teams and team staff.
Training cycles extend the existing training/session model.
The trigger validates the cycle-week relation introduced by training cycles.
The integrity migration hardens the existing match-lineup table.
The membership gate hardens the existing team permission RPCs.
Notification triggers attach to support-ticket status and response changes.
Task notification triggers attach to task assignment and status changes.
The search-path hardening migration alters core organization and admin helper functions introduced by the organization foundation.
The browser write-ACL hardening targets the three organization tables created by the organization foundation.
The team authorization helpers join the organization and active organization-membership tables.
The team authorization helpers require the legacy team and team-staff tables.
The final team authorization helpers call the hardened active-organization manager predicate.
The PFMS membership editor is replaced with serialized active-owner protection; the legacy organization-role helper is tightened against the existing PFSS organization lifecycle.
The replacement keeps the existing organization-manager RPC contract but separates manager operations from platform-admin ownership changes.
Platform administrators are routed to the dedicated serialized legacy-membership RPC that protects the final active owner.
The manager-only replacement relies on the final active-organization can_manage_org authorization helper.
